note: Humboldt-Toiyabe National Forest campground on Blue Lakes Road, about 1.25 miles south of Hwy 88 at the edge of Hope Valley, in Jeffrey and lodgepole pine; rebuilt with single and double sites and a food locker at each. The West Fork Carson River runs through the meadow across the road. Not Hope Valley Resort on Hwy 88. --Claude
